key_results: 75% phase-depth improvement, 87.6% phase-count reduction, 94.22% CNOT-count reduction, 26.99% ancillary-cost reduction vs. state-of-the-art; O(n log n) phase-count
comments: Theoretical improvements significant for NISQ hardware, but practical quantum advantage on real devices remains to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: Fault-tolerant AQFT (Clifford+Z_N group)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Truncating lower-order phase operators achieves linear phase-depth with polynomially small error
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; maintains accuracy while reducing phase-depth 75%

title: Equitable revenue allocation in DEA under a common set of weights: a unified optimization approach
task: Equitable revenue allocation using common set of weights in DEA
key_results: Framework preserves efficiency ratio and common weight ratio invariance; eliminates zero-weight issues and zero-revenue allocations with wider allocation span across DMUs
comments: Addresses practical gap between theoretical DEA evaluation and managerial acceptability, but generalization to other allocation problems is unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lower-bound restrictions on virtual weights eliminate common zero-weight problem
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; framework achieves complete elimination of zero-revenue outcomes

title: The contagion effect: time-varying volatility spillovers between cryptocurrencies and commodities during systemic shocks
task: Analyze dynamic volatility spillovers between cryptocurrencies and commodities
key_results: Total spillover index = 58.68% of volatility forecast error variation; spillovers surged 84% during COVID-19 peak; short-term spillovers (65.40%) dominate medium/long-term
comments: Identifies hierarchy of risk transmitters and receivers, but limited guidance on practical hedging strategy given dominance of short-term spillovers.

model_io.model: TVP-VAR-DY and TVP-VAR-BK
inputs: daily returns of 10 cryptocurrencies, 3 commodities, USDX (2018-2024)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Systemic shocks (crypto crash 2018, COVID-19, Russia-Ukraine) catalyze financial contagion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; spillovers surged ~84% during pandemic peak

title: From data to decisions: how neural network input structures propagate to air quality policies
task: Surrogate model design effects on air-quality policy optimization outcomes
key_results: Regionalized ANNs achieve relative MAE 2.4-3.3% vs. 6.4% for single-basin model; at higher policy costs, regionalized architectures outperform basin-wide, affecting optimal resource allocation across macrosectors
comments: Demonstrates surrogate model design propagates to policy structure, but cost-effectiveness of regionalization vs. added complexity not quantified.

model_io.model: Alternative ANN architectures (spatial aggregation, weighting strategies)

hypotheses.hypothesis: ANN spatial aggregation strategy affects predictive performance and policy optimization outcomes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; regionalized ANNs outperform basin-wide, especially at higher policy costs

title: VOC observations improve transferable ozone prediction using interpretable machine learning
task: Interpretable machine learning for transferable surface ozone prediction using VOC observations
key_results: VOC incorporation substantially improves model transferability across environments (COVID-19 emission perturbation, rural northern China); VOC predictors provide transferable statistical constraints less dependent on site-specific conditions
comments: VOC importance for transferability is substantive finding, but models reflect statistical associations rather than photochemical mechanisms, limiting mechanistic insight.

model_io.model: Tree-based ensemble (automated ML framework)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Models constructed solely from meteorology and primary pollutants have limited generalization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; poor transferability across environments

hypotheses.hypothesis: VOC observations provide transferable statistical constraints on ozone formation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; substantially improved extrapolation during COVID-19 and at rural site

title: Universal alignment of defect thermodynamics in hematite
task: Unification of defect thermodynamics in hematite via charge-localization protocol
key_results: Charge-localization protocol based on Fe-3d occupation matrix eliminates >2 eV inter-study spread; reduces deviation by ~80%; intrinsic anchor point (Frenkel pair crossing) enables parameter-independent chemical-potential alignment
comments: Resolves a longstanding ~2 eV discrepancy through careful treatment of metastable charge states and error cancellation—essential for reliable defect engineering predictions.

model_io.model: First-principles defect calculations with charge-localization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large inter-study spread in defect energies stems from computational parameter sensitivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; protocol reduces spread 80% by enforcing small-polaron charge localization and intrinsic energy anchoring

title: Noise protected logical qubit in an open chain of superconducting qubits with ultrastrong interactions
task: Coherence-enhanced logical qubit in ultrastrong-interaction superconducting qubit chains
key_results: Logical qubit composed of two lowest eigenstates in alternating XX-YY chains exhibits pure dephasing suppressed to zero and relaxation time doubled vs single physical qubit; high-fidelity single- and two-qubit gates demonstrated
comments: Leverages many-body interactions for noise protection rather than suppression—a elegant route to fault-tolerant logical qubits using naturally strong interactions in fixed-frequency architectures.

model_io.model: Open chain of superconducting qubits with ultrastrong XX-YY interactions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ultrastrong interactions enable coherence protection of encoded logical qubits
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; both dephasing and relaxation suppressed by interaction-induced symmetry protection

title: Fast, unconditional reset and leakage reduction in fixed-frequency transmon qubits
task: Fast unconditional qubit reset and leakage reduction in fixed-frequency transmon qubits
key_results: Tunable-coupler-based reset protocol achieves >99% fidelity in 88 ns total time; unconditionally transfers excitations to readout resonator for decay; compatible with surface code architecture
comments: Addresses a critical requirement for fault-tolerant quantum computing by enabling fast, unconditional state initialization in fixed-frequency architectures—eliminating need for frequency tunability while maintaining speed.

model_io.model: Fixed-frequency transmon qubits with tunable couplers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tunable couplers enable fast unconditional reset without fixed-frequency qubit frequency tunability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 88 ns protocol with >99% fidelity achievable on surface-code-compatible architecture

title: Statistical analysis to investigate the characteristics of Sq and SFE current using the Kakioka magnetometer
task: Statistical analysis of solar flare effect contributions using geomagnetic data
key_results: Geomagnetic Y-component shows strongest dependence on Sq amplitude and flare class; hodogram analysis reveals trajectory shifts synchronized with soft X-ray and EUV flux reversals; evidence for Hall-to-Pedersen conductivity transition
comments: High-resolution multi-wavelength approach clarifies the relative contributions of soft X-rays vs EUV radiation to ionospheric responses, resolving a long-standing ambiguity.

model_io.model: Kakioka Magnetic Observatory + GOES/SDO satellite data analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Soft X-rays are the primary driver of SFE; EUV role remains unresolved
hypotheses.result: Both soft X-rays and EUV drive SFE with distinct spatial-altitude signatures; transition marked by flux reversals

title: The origin of dark lane on sunspot’s light bridge
task: Determination of dark lane formation mechanism in sunspot light bridges
key_results: Dark lanes prominent in Hα, visible continuum, and NIR line core but absent in NIR continuum; altitude evidence suggests dark lane origin in deep photosphere ~30 km below surface
comments: Multi-wavelength GST observations provide crucial altitude-resolved constraints, shifting focus from numerical models to observational characterization of internal structure.

model_io.model: Goode Solar Telescope multi-wavelength imaging
outputs: dark lane signatures at different altitudes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dark lanes in light bridges originate from photospheric magnetic structure
hypotheses.result: Supported; altitude analysis indicates formation in deep photosphere above NIR continuum layer

title: Atomic-scale evidence for continuous surface dislocations in crystalline interfaces
task: Atomic-scale evidence for continuous surface dislocations in grain boundaries
key_results: Nye-tensor analysis reveals discrete dislocation array evolves into continuous distribution with increasing twist angle; both FBE-compliant arrays coexist; grain boundary energy and sliding resistance vary smoothly across transition
comments: Unifies Bilby's 50-year-old theoretical construct with modern atomistic simulations, establishing continuous dislocation distributions as thermodynamically stable and mechanically active.

model_io.model: Atomistic simulation + Nye-tensor analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bilby's surface dislocations are purely mathematical constructs
hypotheses.result: Refuted; continuous dislocation distributions are physically identifiable, thermodynamically stable defect states

title: Biotite as a natural layered dielectric for two-dimensional transistors and memristors
task: Integration of biotite natural mineral as dielectric and switching material for 2D electronics
key_results: MoS₂ FETs with biotite gate dielectric achieve ~10 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ mobility and 20 mV hysteresis; photodetectors reach 392 AW⁻¹ responsivity; metal-insulator-metal memristors exhibit >10⁴ cycle endurance with voltage scaling below 0.5 V at 6 nm thickness
comments: Demonstrates that earth-abundant, mechanically exfoliated layered minerals rival synthetic van der Waals materials in performance—offering scalability and cost advantages for 2D device integration.

model_io.model: Biotite-based van der Waals heterostructures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Natural layered minerals can function as effective dielectrics and switching materials in 2D devices
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; biotite demonstrates performance comparable to synthetic van der Waals materials across multiple device types

title: Realization of unconventional staircase topological Anderson phase transitions
task: Realization of unconventional topological Anderson phase transitions
key_results: Successive disorder-driven topological transitions with stepwise-increasing topological invariant that saturates without reverting to trivial insulator; realized in 1D topolectrical circuit
comments: Challenges conventional understanding that strong disorder destroys topological phases; opens 'topological disordertronics' as new paradigm.

model_io.model: 1D topolectrical circuit (single-wall nanotube emulator)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Topological phases disappear at large disorder
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; robust topological phase persists with stepwise topological invariant in strong-disorder regime

title: Encapsulated CsPbBr3 quantum dots with asymmetric chiral magneto-optoelectronic responses
task: Chiral magneto-optoelectronic responses in encapsulated perovskite quantum dots
key_results: SiO₂-encapsulated CsPbBr₃ quantum dots exhibit asymmetric degree of circular polarization to opposite magnetic fields; chiral features emerge from bright-dark exciton state mixture; encapsulation stabilizes emission while increasing lattice distortion
comments: Encapsulation-induced lattice distortion unexpectedly enhances chiral properties and exciton mixing, opening design pathways for tunable chiral quantum emitters with operational stability.

model_io.model: SiO₂-encapsulated CsPbBr₃ quantum dots under magnetic field

hypotheses.hypothesis: Encapsulation stabilizes perovskite quantum dots while preserving magneto-optoelectronic responses
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with enhancement; encapsulation increases lattice distortion and bright-dark exciton mixing, amplifying chirality

comments: Transforms a fundamental limitation (Rydberg interactions) into an advantage through machine learning, enabling quantum sensing beyond linear response regime.

Mean-field superatom simulation
